decisions.reason: Although it fits the firm's web-GIS knowledge base, the hierarchical search bundle appears niche and no longer visible, so we would fold its know-how into project work or broader platforms rather than keep it as a standalone product.

The mobile layer-control component builds on strong in-house capabilities, but after the initial launch signal its absence suggests it is better treated as reusable functionality inside customer solutions than as a separate marketed product.

As the flagship GIS solution platform most closely aligned with our strategic direction and absorptive strengths, it remains the product with the best basis for continued learning, improvement, and commercialization.

Mobile field data capture is a natural adjacent application for our geospatial integration and R&D capabilities, so despite lower recent visibility it still merits continuation and iterative development.

The search extension for web map apps remains close to our established technical and customer knowledge, and we can still refine and reuse it across implementations even if it is no longer heavily marketed as a standalone offer.
